## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the task and name its
owner. Note the starting commit, agreed scope and any protocol/authority changes.

## Validation

Record commands, tested commit, OS and results. Distinguish automated/synthetic
checks from actual X4 tests; include game build/DLC when relevant. List pending
checks and the exact steps needed on the primary test PC. For documentation-only
changes, describe reference and diff checks instead of running the game.

## Integration and remaining limits

List dependencies or overlapping PRs, required matched client/server updates and
known limitations. State whether the pending 7.0 candidate is affected. Record
durable interface decisions in their owning documentation. Keep generated
packages, session keys and personal installation data out of this PR.
